description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/01798/FUL: Tree Protection Measures (15) and Method of Construction (16) in respect of demolition of existing garages and erection of 4x 4 bedroom dwellings with associated landscaping and vehicular access.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 15 (Tree Protection Measures) of planning permission ref: 25/01798/FUL as the submitted Arboricultural Method Statement does not provide sufficient detail or methodology for the installation of hard surfacing (paths and patios) & cycle store, which encroach into the root protection areas (RPAs) of several retained trees. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy G7 of the London Plan (2021), policy CP36 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), policies DMD 80 and DMD81 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and the British Standard for Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction (BS 5837:2012).
